Trigger, what happens, outcomes and timeouts

Trigger

OrderStatusChangedToShippedIntegrationEvent.

The case is in Shipped.

What happens
  1. Ordering API publishes the shipped event from its outbox.
  2. Event bus carries the event to queue Webhooks.
  3. Webhooks API posts the event to each subscription of its type.
  4. Webhook subscriber endpoint receives the post.
  5. Webhooks database holds the subscriptions.
Other recorded calls (order not recorded)
  • Webhooks API → Webhooks database: subscriptions read
Expected outcome
one post to each OrderShipped subscription (proposed)
If it does not happen
  • Subscribers are not told.
  • Each post retried up to 3 times on a transient failure by the standard resilience handler, response not read.
Timeouts

Each post is bounded only by the standard resilience handler every HTTP client carries:

  • Each attempt 10 seconds, up to 3 retries, 30 seconds in all.
  • The posts to all subscriptions go out together and are awaited together.

No clock watches the message waiting in queue Webhooks.
